checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-session.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" session --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Inspect or export session evidence' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'bootstrap' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'rehydrate' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'handoff' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" session bootstrap --help >"$tmp/boot"; grep -Fq 'Report local orientation files without starting runtimes' "$tmp/boot"; "$tmp/ao" session rehydrate --help >"$tmp/rehy"; grep -Fq 'without consuming it, claiming work' "$tmp/rehy"; work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-session-work.XXXXXX); printf 'x' >"$work/AGENTS.md"; ( cd "$work" && "$tmp/ao" session bootstrap --json >"$tmp/boot.json" ); grep -Fq '"orientation_files"' "$tmp/boot.json"; grep -Fq 'AGENTS.md' "$tmp/boot.json"; empty=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-session-empty.XXXXXX); ( cd "$empty" && "$tmp/ao" session rehydrate --json >"$tmp/rehy.out" 2>"$tmp/rehy.err" ); test "$(tr -d '[:space:]' <"$tmp/rehy.out")" = '{}'; grep -Fq 'no handoff found' "$tmp/rehy.err"
